article_manifest.title: Kidal: six wounded evacuated to Gao, the Fla speaks of released soldiers
article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : six blessés évacués à Gao, le FLA parle de militaires libérés
article_manifest.summary: AT this TIME The International Committee of the Red Cross specifies that it organized this evacuation after obtaining security guarantees from all parties to the conflict. Its press release does not give the identity of the persons transferred and does not specify their status. This discretion corresponds to his mandate as a neutral intermediary and the confidential nature of his dialogue with the belligerents On the same day, the Azawad Liberation Front announced that it had entrusted six wounded Malian soldiers, captured in previous clashes, to the ICRC.

article_manifest.title: Niger: the mutiny that targeted the heart of power
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : la mutinerie qui a visé le cœur du pouvoir
article_manifest.summary: RIGHT NOW The events of August 29th go far beyond a barracks protest. They establish an armed mutiny directed against several strategic sites, but the public elements do not yet allow to reconstitute an organized project of seizure of power Three days after the shots that shook Niamey, the Nigerien authorities are once again in control of Air Base 101, Diori-Hamani International Airport, the presidential palace and the other targeted sites.

article_manifest.title: Targeted financial sanctions: Bamako expands its security pressure tool
article_manifest.original_title: Sanctions financières ciblées : Bamako élargit son outil de pression sécuritaire
article_manifest.summary: AT THIS TIME The text provides for the freezing of the property and economic resources of the persons concerned for six renewable months. It is based on national texts relating to the fight against money laundering, the financing of terrorism and the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction . The grievances are formulated identically for the twelve names: alleged support for JNIM and the Azawad Liberation Front, promotion or apology of terrorism, criminal association and facilitation of terrorist acts.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: the Regional Security Council examines the security situation and recommends strengthening the existing system
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : le Conseil Régional de Sécurité examine la situation sécuritaire et recommande un renforcement du dispositif existant
article_manifest.summary: The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired, on Wednesday, March 11, 2026, the regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS), held in the usual meeting room in the Governorate of Agadez . This meeting allowed the members of this forum to examine the security situation in the region and identify the measures necessary to strengthen the protection of populations and their property.

article_manifest.title: BAMEX 2025: A strategic strengthening of military cooperation in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: BAMEX 2025 : Un renforcement stratégique de la coopération militaire au Mali
article_manifest.summary: This exhibition, which takes place in two phases, began with an exhibition at the Bamako Exhibition Park and continues with practical demonstrations at the Boubacar Sada Sy Center in Koulikoro. It offers a unique opportunity to discover state-of-the-art equipment, presented by more than 30 international companies, mainly Turkish, but also Russian and Chinese .

article_manifest.title: FAMa: positions of armed groups targeted in Abéïbara and near Sévaré
article_manifest.original_title: FAMa : des positions de groupes armés ciblées à Abéïbara et près de Sévaré
article_manifest.summary: AT THIS MOMENT The Malian army continues its air operations against the armed groups active in the country. In a statement issued Wednesday, August 26, the General Staff of the Armed Forces reported a series of strikes in the north and center of Mali, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the military hierarchy, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible, on Monday, August 24, to locate several regroupment points of armed terrorist groups in Abéïbara, in the Kidal region.

article_manifest.title: 65th anniversary of the Malian Army: the nation pays tribute to its forces
article_manifest.original_title: 65ᵉ anniversaire de l’Armée malienne : la nation rend hommage à ses forces
article_manifest.summary: Mali commemorated this Tuesday the 65th anniversary of the creation of its national army, on the occasion of an official ceremony presided over by the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces .

article_manifest.title: Counter-terrorism: IATTC and DIRPA train journalists to deconstruct extremist narratives
article_manifest.original_title: Lutte contre le terrorisme : la CIMCT et la DIRPA forment des journalistes à la déconstruction des discours extrémistes
article_manifest.summary: The Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCTC), in collaboration with the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), closed this Friday, October 2, 2026, a training session devoted to the analysis of extremist and hate speech in digital media . From September 28 to October 2, 2026, media professionals as well as members of the Defense and Security Forces (FDS) took part in this session organized around the theme: “Analysis of Extremist Speech and Hate Speech in Digital Media: Tools and Techniques for Intelligent Confrontation” .

article_manifest.title: Algeria sent fighter jets to Niger to thwart ‘coup attempt’, president says
article_manifest.original_title: Algeria sent fighter jets to Niger to thwart ‘coup attempt’, president says
article_manifest.summary: Algeria’s President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has said that his country sent fighter jets to Niger in late August to help thwart a “coup attempt” that shook the capital, Niamey. The confirmation came in excerpts from Tebboune’s interview with local media outlets that was broadcast on Saturday ahead of its full release.

article_manifest.title: Senou: A dangerous network of inoperable motorcycle robbers
article_manifest.original_title: Sénou : Un dangereux réseau de braqueurs de motos hors d’état de nuire
article_manifest.summary: FIGHT AGAINST DELINQUENCY and CRIME: As part of the strengthening of security, the Senou Police Station, headed by Chief Police Commissioner Cheickna SOW, arrested three (03) individuals suspected of being members of a criminal network on 19 September 2026 The operation, carried out by the Research Brigade, follows the denunciation of several cases of motorcycle theft in the peripheral districts of Bamako and the surrounding localities, sometimes followed by robberies.

article_manifest.title: Algeria's president reveals behind the scenes of sending fighter jets to thwart coup attempt in Niger
article_manifest.original_title: رئيس الجزائر يكشف كواليس إرسال مقاتلات لإحباط محاولة انقلاب فى النيجر
article_manifest.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune revealed that his country sent fighter jets to Niger at the end of last August to thwart a coup attempt, stressing that his country's military move came in response to "provocations" to Algeria. In excerpts from an interview Tebboune gave to local media, the Algerian president explained that his Nigerian counterpart Mohamed Lamine Zine was on a visit to the country, and returned at night to his country, before a coup attempt took place.

article_manifest.title: Fight against terrorism: Captain (Navy) Ibrahima Sow invites the media to collaborate more with DIRPA
article_manifest.original_title: Lutte contre le terrorisme : le capitaine de vaisseau Ibrahima Sow invite les médias à davantage collaborer avec la DIRPA
article_manifest.summary: The Director of the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Captain (Navy) Ibrahima Sow, recalled the role of the media in the prevention of hate speech and violent extremism, on the occasion of the closing of the training organized by the Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCT) . According to the Director of DIRPA, the IMCT is an alliance of 43 states with a common Muslim religion, which are committed to organizing against terrorism and violent extremism in their regions .

article_manifest.title: Supply: A convoy of 643 tanker trucks arrives in Bamako under military escort
article_manifest.original_title: Approvisionnement : Un convoi de 643 camions-citernes arrive à Bamako sous escorte militaire
article_manifest.summary: A large convoy of more than 643 tanker trucks entered the Malian capital this Saturday, October 3, 2026, at around 7 a.m., after a night escort provided by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) . The convoy advanced all night under the protection of the military, kilometer after kilometer, before reaching Bamako at dawn. This operation is part of the continuous strengthening of the supply of petroleum products on the national territory .

article_manifest.title: Coup in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention
article_manifest.original_title: Coup d'état au Niger : L’Algérie dénonce une "provocation" et révèle son intervention militaire
article_manifest.summary: Coup d 'état in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention The Algerian President, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, strongly reaffirmed his country's unconditional support for Niger. During his regular meeting with the national press, the Head of State unveiled unprecedented details on Algiers' reaction to the recent coup attempt, described as an act of major destabilization .

article_manifest.title: Government exhibition The minister in charge of war, Célestin Simporé, exchanges with citizens
article_manifest.original_title: Exposition gouvernementale Le ministre chargé de la guerre, Célestin Simporé échange avec les citoyens
article_manifest.summary: The Minister of State, Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé, moderated the first session of the "Dialogue with the People" on the theme "Governance, National Security: The Standing People Account to You", Friday, October 2, 2026, at the SIAO . The Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé lent himself to an exercise of government accountability to the people on Friday, October 2, 2026 at the SIAO .

article_manifest.title: Mali: Arrival in Bamako of an exceptional convoy of more than 643 tankers under military escort
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Arrivée à Bamako d’un convoi exceptionnel de plus de 643 camions-citernes sous escorte militaire
article_manifest.summary: While Bamako slept, a long column of tankers advanced into the night, under the watchful protection of our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). Kilometre after kilometre, our soldiers watched over each vehicle. This Saturday, October 3, 2026, around 7 a.m., at daybreak, more than 643 tankers entered the capital.

article_manifest.title: Gourma/Security: 600 national VDPs complete their training to strengthen the security of the region - 'Agence d 'Information du Burkina (AIB)
article_manifest.original_title: Gourma/Sécurité : 600 VDP nationaux achèvent leur formation pour renforcer la sécurisation de la région - 'Agence d'Information du Burkina (AIB)
article_manifest.summary: Gourma/Security: 600 national VDPs complete their training to strengthen the security of the region 'Burkina Information Agency (AIB)

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso's military leaders mark four years in power
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso's military leaders mark four years in power
article_manifest.summary: People gathered in Ougadougou’s Place de la Révolution on Wednesday night to mark four years since Captain Ibrahim Traoré came to power in a coup. The culmination of anniversary celebrations, they paid tribute to the armed forces and the military government’s achievements in Burkina Faso. One resident, Abdoul Rasmané Sawadogo, said military leaders have created an “ultra-modern army that meets expectations”.

article_manifest.title: 6 Burkina Faso: Night of the People's Progressive Revolution - The main achievements presented to the population
article_manifest.original_title: 6 Burkina Faso: Nuit de la Révolution progressiste populaire - Les principaux acquis présentés à la population
article_manifest.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was an opportunity to present the main achievements made during the four years of Captain Ibrahim Traoré. From the reconquest of the territory to diplomacy, via agriculture, health and culture, everything demonstrates that Burkina Faso is resolutely committed to its sovereignty and development . In addition to the tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP), the first edition of the night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was a real moment of accountability.

article_manifest.title: Mali: more than 2,400 schools remain closed as insecurity disrupts new school year
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: more than 2,400 schools remain closed as insecurity disrupts new school year
article_manifest.summary: Mali's new school year began Thursday with more than 2,400 schools unable to reopen, as worsening insecurity and the growing presence of jihadist groups continue to disrupt education. The 2026-2027 academic year has been declared the “Year of Education and Culture” by President Assimi Goïta, but thousands of children are starting the year without access to their classrooms.

article_manifest.title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world
article_manifest.original_title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso has inaugurated its first gold refinery as its military-led government seeks to strengthen economic sovereignty after breaking ties with its traditional Western partners. “From now on, Burkina Faso’s gold must not only be mined in Burkina Faso; it must also be processed, controlled, valued and certified there,” President Ibrahim Traoré said on Monday at the inauguration of the refinery, named Raffinor-BF.

article_manifest.title: Crash of the Ouagadougou-Alger flight: Swiftair condemned
article_manifest.original_title: Crash du vol Ouagadougou-Alger: Swiftair condamnée
article_manifest.summary: The families of the victims had to wait twelve years. Gathered within the association "AH-5017 Ensemble", they led a "relentless fight for truth and justice" which is now experiencing its judicial outcome. The Spanish company Swiftair is found guilty of manslaughter this Monday morning by the Paris Criminal Court .

article_manifest.title: Crash of the Air Algérie flight AH5017 in Mali, the judgment expected in Paris
article_manifest.original_title: Crash du vol Air Algérie AH5017 au Mali, le jugement attendu à Paris
article_manifest.summary: Twelve years after the crash of Air Algérie flight AH5017, judgment is expected on Monday, September 28, 2026 in Paris. The aircraft, operated by the Spanish company Swiftair and chartered by Air Algérie, crashed on 24 July 2014 near Gossi, in the Timbuktu region. All 116 people on board, including a Malian, had perished.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: Ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS)
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : Réunion ordinaire du Conseil Régional de Sécurité (CRS)
article_manifest.summary: Agadez, Sept. 24 (ANP) – The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa chaired, on Thursday, September 24, 2026, an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS). Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region .

article_manifest.title: Niger: several soldiers fallen at the front and dozens of "mercenaries" neutralized in a new terrorist attack towards Abala
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : plusieurs soldats tombés au front et des dizaines de « mercenaires » neutralisés dans une nouvelle attaque terroriste vers Abala
article_manifest.summary: Several Nigerien soldiers fell on the battlefield and others were wounded in a new terrorist attack on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, in the Fartal area, located 22 km east of Abala, in the Tillabéri region, announced the Minister of National Defence in a statement issued in the evening According to the same source, violent clashes took place between Nigerien soldiers, in an operation to intercept a convoy of cattle stolen the day before in the area, and a large column of "motorcycle mercenaries" and "heavily armed" .

article_manifest.title: Niger: what we know about the jihadist attack that targeted Niamey airport
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: ce que lon sait de lattaque jihadiste qui a visé laéroport de Niamey
article_manifest.summary: Niger: what we know about the jihadist attack that targeted the Niamey airport Published on Saturday, January 31, 2026 | AFP In the night from Wednesday to Thursday, the Niamey airport in Niger suffered a brief attack claimed Friday by the Islamic State, in a country where jihadist violence usually occurs in the west and south-east The Nigerien military junta, helped by "Russian partners", accused the French, Beninese and Ivorian presidents of being the "sponsors" of the attackers, words condemned by Abidjan and Cotonou on Friday.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Islamic State claims responsibility for attack on Niamey airport
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: l’Etat islamique revendique l’attaque de l’aéroport de Niamey
article_manifest.summary: Published on Friday, January 30, 2026 | AFP The Islamic State claimed responsibility on Friday for the attack on Niamey airport in Niger, said the Site group, which specializes in counter-terrorism research . On the night of Wednesday to Thursday, Niamey airport, which is home to military sites and is about ten kilometers from the presidency, was the target of an attack leaving 20 dead on the attacking side, according to the Nigerien military junta .

article_manifest.title: Drug trafficking: two young people in their twenties arrested with 12,000 Tramadol tablets at the Tillabéri road barrier
article_manifest.original_title: Trafic de drogue : deux jeunes dune vingtaine dannées interpellés avec 12 000 comprimés de Tramadol à la barrière de la route de Tillabéri
article_manifest.summary: Published on Tuesday, December 30, 2025 | actuniger.com The vigilance of the security forces has once again borne fruit . On December 22, 2025, officers of the Yantala Police Station seized 12,000 Tramadol tablets during a routine check at the Tillabéri road barrier, thwarting an attempt to transport drugs to a gold site in the region, with the arrest of two young Nigeriens in their twenties .

article_manifest.title: Agadez: the SDF repulse an attack in Abalama  two bandits neutralized, equipment seized, one soldier killed and four wounded
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : les FDS repoussent une attaque à Abalama  deux bandits neutralisés, matériel saisi, un soldat tué et quatre blessés
article_manifest.summary: Agadez: SDF repels attack in Abalama – two bandits neutralized, equipment seized, one soldier killed and four wounded Published on Friday, September 5, 2025 | actuniger.com On Tuesday, September 2, 2025, the Defense and Security Forces (SDF) successfully repulsed two simultaneous attacks targeting the positions of the National Guard detachment in Abalama, Aderbissanat Department .
